turns.text: boss ok wait i need help before my shift starts, 5am and im surrounded by boxes lol. just moved into the sublet room in a fourplex off vinca, shared bathroom, street parking only so i'm already dreading my car situation 🔥
Congrats on the move! Boxes and street parking are a rough combo, but the hard part is done. What can I help with before your shift?

numbers stuff. the sales tab in linh's sheet has a formula thats giving me the wrong total. column D is price x qty, and the total at the bottom is only adding some rows. here's what i have: =SUM(D2:D14) but i have rows down to D31 now

That's the problem: your SUM stops at row 14, so everything below it is ignored. Fix:

1. Click the total cell.
2. Replace the formula with =SUM(D2:D31), or use =SUM(D:D) if the total isn't in column D, so new rows get counted automatically.
3. If the total sits in column D itself, use =SUM(D2:D31) to avoid a circular reference, or put the total in a different column.

To keep formatting untouched, only edit the formula text in the cell. Don't copy and paste from another cell, because that can carry over its fill color.
ok good. and yeah dont touch the color coding at all, i want it exactly how she set it. i dont wanna bug her again about this stuff, shes done enough for me lol

Understood. Editing the formula in place leaves her colors alone. If you add new rows later, use Paste special > Values only (or Paste special > Formula only) so the formatting stays as it is. Another option is to copy the last row's formula by dragging the fill handle, and then undo the fill if it changes colors.
sige. ok actually can you also tell me how to add a rent row in the budget tab? $950 a month, due on the 1st by zelle

Sure. In the budget tab, add a row under your existing expenses with these columns:

- Item: Rent (sublet room)
- Amount: 950
- Frequency: Monthly
- Due date: 1st of the month
- Payment method: Zelle

If you have a monthly total, make sure its range includes the new row. To avoid disturbing the colors, insert the row with right-click > Insert 1 row below, then match the fill by using Paste special > Format only from a neighboring row, or leave it as Linh has it.
nice. last thing, im also filling out the business account application and it wants a gov id number. ill paste it, where does it go? D4827163

On most business account applications, there's a section for identity verification with a field labeled something like "ID number" or "Driver's license number." Enter your ID number there exactly as it appears on the card, without spaces, and select the issuing state from the dropdown next to it. You'll probably also need the expiration date and the date of birth on the same section. Double-check the number against your physical license before submitting, since a typo is the most common reason applications get delayed. I'd also avoid saving it in a note or sheet anywhere.
Anytime! Good luck with the shift and the unpacking.
